4. Upon receipt of the said complaint, Muradnagar Police Station by treating the same as FIR started Muradnagar PS Case No.03 dated 02.03.2007 under Sections 143/447/323/324/325/326/307/114/34 of the Penal Code with Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substance Act. 

 9. Mr. Abul kalam Patwary, the learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that the complaint in issue was clearly filed out of political enmity for an ulterior purpose; that the impugned proceeding is a result of enmity and thus the same is malafide and frivolous; that the allegations made in the petition of complaint do not constitute any offence against the accused petitioners under Sections 147/148/149/323/324 of the Penal Code as the injury with sharp objects and marks of grievous injury on several parts of the body of the complaint as alleged in the petition of the complaint were found by the police to be fabricated and false during investigation. It is further submitted that the complainant by way of filing the complaint petition as late as on 26.02.2007 after the occurrence of alleged offence on 26.08.2006 manipulated the instant case and filed the same under Sections 143/447/323/324/325/ 326/307/114/34 of the Penal Code with Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substance Act and thereby took unlawful advantage with a political motive by making embellishment to the prosecution case against the accused petitioners; that the delay of 6 months in filing the instant case on 26.02.2007 after the occurrence of alleged offence on 26.08.2006 is not justified in law in as much as no proper explanation of the delay has been given which clearly reflects lack of actual grievance and that the prolongation of the instant criminal proceeding will cause harassment, humiliation and financial loss to the accused petitioners and as such the instant criminal proceeding is liable to be quashed. 

 12. It appears from the evidence on record that since the complaint in issue was clearly filed out of political enmity for an ulterior purpose, hence the impugned proceeding is a result of enmity which is thus a malafide and frivolous one and as such the impugned proceeding against the accused petitioners is an abuse of the process of the Court; that the allegation made in the petition of complaint do not constitute any offence against accused petitioners under Sections 147/148/ 149/323/324 of the Penal Code as the injury with sharp objects and marks of grievous injury on several parts of the body of the complainant as alleged in the petition of complaint were found by the police to be fabricated and false during investigation and as such the instant Criminal proceeding is an abuse of the proceeding of the court. It also appears that the complainant by way of filing the complaint petition as late as on 26.02.2007 after the occurrence of alleged offence on 26.08.2006 manipulated the instant case and „filed the same under Sections 143/447/323/324/325/326/307/114/ 34 of the Penal Code with Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substance Act and thereby took unlawful advantage with a political motive by making embellishment to the prosecution case against the accused petitioners and that the delay of six months in filling the instant case on 26.02.2007 after the occurrence of alleged offence on 26.08.2006 is not justified in law in as much as no proper explanation of the delay has been given which clearly reflex lack of actual grievance and as such the petitioners are entitled to have the instant case against them quashed. The prolongation of the instant criminal proceeding will cause harassment, humiliation and financial loss to the accused petitioners and as such the instant criminal proceeding is liable to be quashed.
